title: Imperial Capital Ruins
next_chapter_hook: Chen Tianming's voice echoed within the Imperial Mausoleum: "Son, the Heavenly Dao is not invincible—the key lies in breaking its causal anchor."

text.content: While Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons, a violent Spiritual Energy fluctuation came from the direction of Tianqing Sect—someone was forcibly breaking through the sect's protective great formation. That wave of Spiritual Energy surged like terrifying waves, causing even the seals deep within the Imperial Mausoleum to hum, and countless stone tablets sealed for ten thousand years began to glow with an eerie light.

dialogue.content: "Brother! Something's happened at Tianqing Sect!" Chen Nian's voice came from the depths of the Imperial Mausoleum, carrying unprecedented urgency. She stumbled out from behind the altar, her face pale as paper, the tendons at her temples throbbing from extreme tension. "I can sense... it's Ling Yuan! He's brought at least three Transfiguration God Realm experts!"

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back on the Eight Trigrams platform at the center of the Imperial Mausoleum, his expression terrifyingly calm. His divine sense extended from the mausoleum like a wisp of smoke, instantly covering a hundred li—all he could see was the Tianqing Sect's protective great formation崩裂ing at a visible speed, countless disciples fleeing in panic, and those three terrifying auras rushing directly toward the Inner Sect. There... was where Su Qingyao was in seclusion.

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, I was planning to let you live a few more days. I didn't expect you couldn't wait." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, yet there was no warmth whatsoever in that smile. His fingers gently brushed his left eye, and the fragment of the Tianji Record trembled within his pupil—the scales of fate slowly unfolded before him: in three hours, the Tianqing Sect Inner Sect would become a scorched wasteland.

text.content: A brilliant golden light suddenly illuminated the depths of the Imperial Mausoleum. A hoarse yet majestic voice emerged from the stone coffin at the center of the altar: "My son, you have finally arrived." Although the voice was weak, it carried an irresistible pressure, as if it had traversed countless ages, bearing the Heavenly Dao's might that commands obedience without anger.

dialogue.content: "Father?!" Chen Nian gasped, her eyes instantly reddening. "Father isn't already..." Her voice choked. Her hands tightly gripped Chen Ji's sleeve. The stone coffin on the altar slowly cracked open, and a wisp of golden soul rose from within. Although the soul was fragmented, one could vaguely make out features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji.

text.content: "This is merely a remnant will I left behind." Chen Tianming's soul gazed at his children, a flicker of relief and guilt passing through his eyes. "When I sealed the channel through which the Heavenly Dao descends, I sacrificed my life. The Imperial Mausoleum gate is not simply a place of inheritance—it is a lock, sealing the Heavenly Dao's eye that gazes upon the mortal world."

dialogue.content: "Why did Father keep this from me?" Chen Ji's voice was calm, but his clenched fists betrayed the turmoil within. "If I had known the truth about the mausoleum sooner, I wouldn't have..." He didn't finish, but Chen Tianming seemed to see through his thoughts, a bitter smile appearing on his fragmented lips.

text.content: "The Heavenly Dao's eye is everywhere." Chen Tianming's soul drifted toward the altar in the depths of the mausoleum, where a dust-covered stone monument slowly rose. "If I had told you the truth, you would have unconsciously sought a solution, and this very desire itself would be detected by the Heavenly Dao. I have laid this chess game for a hundred years, all for the sake of letting you find the key to reversing fate in the most impossible place."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at the stone monument. The tablet surface was covered with密密麻麻 of runes, each pattern resonating with the fragment of the Tianji Record in his possession. His pupils contracted sharply—this was precisely the third page of the Tianji Record he had sought for years! So it had been hidden here all along! "This is... the complete version of the Tianji Record?"

text.content: "No, this is merely the core of the Tianji Record." Chen Tianming's soul lightly tapped the monument, and countless runes flowed like water, ultimately converging into a complex formation diagram. "The true Tianji Record has three pages. The one in your hands allows you to glimpse three hours into the future, but this page... can rewrite causality that has already occurred. As for the third page, it lies within the main body of the Heavenly Dao's Eye."

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's words plunged Chen Ji into deep thought. At this moment, the crisis at Tianqing Sect was imminent, Su Qingyao's life hung by a thread, and the ultimate inheritance in the mausoleum lay right before his eyes. He had to make a choice—

choices.description: Fuse with the Tianji Record Core immediately, gain the ability to rewrite causality, rush back to Tianqing Sect to save Su Qingyao at the first moment—the cost is a massive consumption of Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Gained "Cause-and-Effect Rewriting" ability: can reverse events that occurred within three hours
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate will drop to a dangerous zone, possibly triggering a fatal backlash

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate for an instant. He stepped onto the altar, both palms pressing against the monument. Golden runes instantly flooded into his body, and the fragment of the Tianji Record violently resonated with the core. Agonizing pain tore through his divine soul like thunder. Blood seeped from his seven orifices, yet his eyes were clearer than ever before.

dialogue.content: "Brother!" Chen Nian cried out, wanting to rush forward, but Chen Tianming's soul blocked her. "Let him go." Chen Tianming's voice carried a hint of resolve. "This trial, he must pass through on his own."

choices.memory_label: 陈机为救苏青瑶不惜代价

choices.description: Not rushing to fuse with the core, first use existing Tianji Record abilities to deduce the optimal rescue route, return to help with minimum cost. Reserve the mausoleum core for the decisive battle.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal rescue timing
choices.visible_reward: Retain a complete hidden card—complete information of the mausoleum core
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might not survive until the reinforcements arrive

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record fragments spinning frantically within his pupils. Endless images flickered past like a lantern carousel—every possible path, every node of variables, weaving into an intricate web in his mind. He opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flashing within: "Got it."

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan wants to break open the Imperial Mausoleum gate, let him. Chen Ji plans to open the channel himself, using Heavenly Secrets power to rebound against Ling Yuan—the cost being the exposure of his own existence.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose his identity and form a deadly feud with the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance
choices.visible_reward: Permanently eliminate Ling Yuan, shocking the entire cultivation world
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Secrets Eye might descend directly, and the situation will spiral completely out of control

text.content: A cruel smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He turned to gaze at the stone gate deep within the Imperial Mausoleum, sealed for ten thousand years, and flicked his finger lightly. The runes on the seal instantly dimmed, the stone gate emitting a low rumble as it slowly cracked open—a pressure from the depths of Heavenly Secrets gushed forth like a tidal wave.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择以险棋对抗凌渊

text.content: Just then, a violent tremor echoed from the entrance of the Imperial Mausoleum. A boisterous laughter pierced through the layered barriers, reaching deep into the tomb: "Hahaha! Chen Ji's aura is here! I've been hunting you for twenty years—today, there's nowhere left to escape!" The voice resounded like a great bell, making the entire mausoleum tremble.

dialogue.content: "Oh?" Chen Ji turned slowly, a cold glint flickering in his gaze. "Who else but you, you undying wretch. Twenty years ago you relied on the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance's power to forcibly force my father to abdicate, then set up the humiliation of the broken engagement in the Imperial Capital to sever the Tianji Record's inheritance—now you have the nerve to say you've been searching for me for twenty years?"

text.content: The mausoleum's stone gate was blasted open by a savage force, and a stooped figure radiating terrifying presence strode in. It was a withered elder, silver hair cascading over his shoulders, deep-set eyes, yet a pair gleaming with golden light—the unique mark of a Heavenly Secrets Guardian. Behind him trailed two cloaked figures with unfathomable auras.

dialogue.content: "I am Bai Ze, one of the Seven Elders of the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance." The wizened elder cackled sinisterly, his murky eyes assessing Chen Ji like a lamb awaiting slaughter. "Twenty years ago I failed to personally end your father—today I can seize the opportunity—the Tianji Record's inheritor, delivered right to my doorstep!"

text.content: Bai Ze's wild laughter echoed through the mausoleum, yet Chen Ji simply gazed at him placidly, even a faint smile tugging at his lips. That smile stirred an inexplicable unease in Bai Ze—he had seen that expression before, twenty years prior when Chen Tianming achieved martyrdom. "What are you laughing at?"

dialogue.content: "I laugh at your foolishness." Chen Ji strode toward the altar, voice low yet crystal clear to every ear. "You believe you've come to kill me? No—you've come bearing gifts. One of the Seven Elders of the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance shall fall today—and I won't shed a single drop of blood."

choice.prompt: The moment Chen Ji finished speaking, Bai Ze sensed something was terribly wrong—the stone gate that should have remained eternally sealed was gradually opening, Heavenly Secrets power pouring forth like a raging tide. Bai Ze's complexion shifted dramatically: "Impossible! The seal was clearly... What have you done?!"

choices.description: Expose his trump cards and schemes in detail before Bai Ze, leaving him utterly humiliated, savoring the thrill of crushing victory.
choices.visible_reward: Bai Ze's Dao heart collapses, combat power greatly diminished
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Bai Ze to desperate measures

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze like watching a jumping clown. "Bai Ze, the Seven Elders' master schemer? Hmph, back then you coveted my Chen family's Tianji Record—first framing my father for treason, then manipulating the Imperial Capital's noble families to force the broken engagement—were those characters on the cancellation letter forged by your own hand?"

dialogue.content: "Did you think I didn't know? The Tianji Record can glimpse past and future—everything you've done, I remember with perfect clarity." Chen Ji's voice grew colder. "Including fifteen years ago, after your failed assassination attempt on my mother, the scene you fabricated to frame the Demonic Path—would you like me to recreate it here for you?"

choices.memory_label: 陈机当众揭露白泽罪行

choices.description: Take no unnecessary action, letting the Heavenly Secrets power of the descent channel naturally rebound upon Bai Ze, achieving maximum results at minimum cost.
choices.visible_reward: Bai Ze was killed by the backlash of Heavenly Dao Power, while Chen Ji remained completely unharmed.
choices.risk_hint: Bai Ze might have seen through his intentions and escaped in advance.

text.content: Chen Ji no longer spoke, standing silently in place with an eerily calm gaze. Bai Ze felt chills under that stare, and just as he was about to strike, he noticed the ground beneath his feet beginning to crack, golden light gushing from the fissures and engulfing him entirely.

choices.description: Without further words, directly crush Bai Ze with thunderous methods,震慑全场 and demonstrate absolute power suppression.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Spiritual Energy.
choices.visible_reward: Bai Ze was killed instantly, his two subordinates fled in terror.
choices.risk_hint: May expose more of my strength and attract more enemies.

text.content: Before his words even finished, Chen Ji had already moved. His figure left an afterimage in place, and the next moment he appeared before Bai Ze, slapping toward his fontanel. That palm seemed ordinary yet contained terrifying power sufficient to destroy an entire realm.

At this moment, Chen Tianming's soul suddenly trembled violently, the remnant soul dissipating at a visible rate. 'Ji'er, remember—the Heavenly Dao is not invincible. The key lies in breaking its causal anchor!' His voice grew fainter. 'The third page of the Tianji Record is in the... Heavenly Dao's Eye... the true body...' Before his words finished, the soul had completely turned into specks of golden light, merging into the stone tablet.

'Father!' Chen Nian knelt on the ground, tears flowing like rain. Chen Ji silently helped his sister up, his gaze falling upon the soul that had merged with the stone tablet. His fists clenched until his knuckles turned white, yet he uttered no sound. After a moment, he took a deep breath, turned, and looked toward the direction of Tianqing Sect outside the imperial tomb—the spiritual energy fluctuations there had become so faint they were almost imperceptible.

Tianqing Sect's护山大阵 had completely collapsed. Chen Ji's divine sense pierced through the heavy mist and witnessed the scene in the inner sect—Su Qingyao covered in blood, yet still standing with her sword raised before the disciples. And facing her, Ling Yuan was leading three cultivators at the Nascent Soul Transformation stage, encircling her completely. 'Hand over the inheritor of the Tianji Record, and this old man will spare your life,' Ling Yuan sneered wickedly.

dialogue.content: 'Bah!' Su Qingyao spat out a mouthful of blood, coldly laughing. 'Thattrash Chen Ji, what makes him worth all this trouble from you?' Yet a complex light flickered in her eyes—she certainly knew Chen Ji was notrash, but she would never let anyone know. 'The person you're looking for isn't even in the sect!'

text.content: Chen Ji's divine sense captured this scene, the corners of his mouth slightly rising. This girl Su Qingyao, at critical moments she was indeed stubborn—she could have betrayed him to save her own life, yet she insisted on holding on to the end. This favor, he would remember. The tremors in the imperial tomb grew increasingly intense, as if the opening of the descent passage had triggered some kind of chain reaction, with countless beings sealed for ten thousand years beginning to awaken.

choice.prompt: The tremors in the imperial tomb grew more violent, countless runes peeling from the walls to reveal even more ancient inscriptions beneath. Chen Ji knew he had to make a final decision before the decisive battle—these inscriptions recorded the ultimate method to counter the Heavenly Dao, but they also meant he would completely stand against the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

choices.description: Accept all legacies left by my father, gain the ultimate power to counter the Heavenly Dao, but also become completely bound to the因果 of the Tianji Record, becoming an inescapable enemy of the Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all retreat paths, become a mandatory kill target of the Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_reward: The three pages of the Tianji Record unite as one, gaining complete Heavenly Secrets power.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye may descend immediately.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and pressed his palm against the stone tablet. Golden runes flowed into his body like a tide, intensely resonating with the fragment. The three pages of the Tianji Record—past, present, future—slowly merged within his Mental Sea, transforming into a complete golden tome. His eyes turned pure gold, and an aura surpassing the Nascent Soul Transformation stage erupted from his body.

choices.memory_label: 陈机接受完整天机录传承

choices.description: Only accept partial power, leaving the complete inheritance for my sister Chen Nian as insurance. In case I fall, the Chen family would still have a successor.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains the possibility of inheriting, ensuring the continuation of the Chen bloodline.
choices.risk_hint: Combat Power insufficient to face the upcoming crisis

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Chen Nian, gently stroking her forehead. "Nian Nian, your father's legacy, we each take half." His voice was unprecedentedly gentle. "If I fall today, you become the Chen family's last hope—but I will not fall." Golden light surged from his palm, splitting into two streams—one staying with him, the other flowing into Chen Nian's body.

choices.memory_label: 陈机将传承分给妹妹以备万一

choices.description: Rather than claiming the legacy, instead using the stone tablet's power to actively destroy the Descent Channel, fundamentally preventing the possibility of Heavenly Tribulation's descent, but also losing an important bargaining chip against Heavenly Tribulation.
choices.visible_cost: Loss of complete Tianji Record legacy
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Tribulation's Descent Channel completely destroyed, Heavenly Tribulation's Eye cannot directly intervene in the mortal realm
choices.risk_hint: May suffer backlash from Heavenly Tribulation, sustain serious injuries

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of desperate madness. "Father said to break the causal anchor—so let's start with your Descent Channel!" He abruptly turned, hands forming seals, the runes on the stone tablet burning frantically, a power capable of tearing apart the heavens erupting from within him, rushing directly toward the stone gate deep within the imperial tomb!

choices.memory_label: 陈机为灭通道不惜代价

text.content: The imperial tomb trembled violently, the radiance of the inscriptions illuminating the entire space. Chen Ji felt the power surging within him—that perception beyond the Transformation God realm, fragments of Heavenly Tribulation's laws, the path his father had paved with his life for him. Meanwhile, a thunderous rumble echoed from the direction of Tianqing Sect outside the imperial tomb—Ling Yuan had finally made his move.

dialogue.content: "Too late." Chen Ji said in a low voice, his figure flashing as he appeared at the entrance of the imperial tomb. He turned back for one final glance at the stone tablet merged with his father's soul, a complex light flickering in his eyes. "Father, wait for my triumphant return." As his words fell, his figure had already turned into a streak of light, racing toward Tianqing Sect.
